script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Prince Industrial Corporation se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapka account kaafi purana hai, lagbhag 8,923 din se aap hamare saath hain, lekin pichle 30 dinon mein sirf 1 active day record hua hai aur 4 buyer leads ka koi bhi reply nahi gaya — toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, pehle yeh samajhna chahta hoon — kya koi specific wajah hai ki platform pe login kam ho gaya? Kya business side pe kuch busy period chal raha hai, ya platform use karne mein koi dikkat aa rahi hai?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important cheez share karna chahta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 24 hai, jo critical zone mein hai; iska matlab hai ki jab bhi koi buyer Malerkotla ya aapki category mein search karta hai, aapka catalog unhe practically dikh hi nahi raha. Yeh wahi time tha jab 4 mahine pehle aapki activity strong thi — us waqt leads aa rahe the, ab cliff aa gayi hai.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai ji, abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapko guide karta hoon, aap apna IndiaMART account open karein, hum milke sirf 2 cheezein fix karenge: ek product image update aur PNS answer setting check karenge, taaki yeh 4 pending buyer leads mein se jo bhi recover ho sake, ho sake.
script_parts.close: Bas itna commitment chahiye abhi — agle 3 din mein ek baar login karein aur in 4 unanswered leads ko dekh lein; main 3 din baad ek short follow-up call karoonga, aur agar koi issue aaya toh hum saath milke solve karenge — theek hai, bhai ji?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Prince Industrial Corporation? I'm calling from IndiaMART — I noticed your account is nearly 8,923 days old, which shows a long relationship with us, but in the last 30 days there's been only 1 active day recorded and 4 buyer leads have gone completely unanswered, so I felt it was important to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Before anything else, I'd like to understand — is there a specific reason platform logins have dropped off? Is it a busy period on the business side, or is there some difficulty using the platform itself?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a critical data point: your CQS score is currently 24, which is in the critical zone — practically meaning buyers searching in Malerkotla or your product category are not finding your catalog at all. This is a sharp drop from 4 months ago when your activity was strong and leads were coming in — it's a sudden cliff, and it's recoverable if we act now.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — if you can open your IndiaMART account, I'll guide you through two quick fixes: updating at least one product image and checking your PNS answer settings, so we can maximize the chance of recovering responses from those 4 pending buyer leads.
script_parts_en.close: All I'm asking for right now is one small commitment — log in once in the next 3 days and review those 4 unanswered leads; I'll do a short follow-up call in 3 days, and if anything comes up, we'll sort it out together — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
